text: Critical Brake Thermal Procedure: Brake temperature exceeding 200.0 C indicates severe thermal saturation risk on haul ramps. Mandatory immediate action is emergency_stop. Never continue normal haulage above 200.0 C.
Critical Engine Overheating Procedure: Engine coolant temperature above 105.0 C requires immediate execution of activate_cooling to prevent cylinder head warping and seizure.

Transmission Reverse Interlock: Operator command R (reverse gear) while vehicle speed is above 0.0 km/h causes catastrophic gearbox damage. Mandatory action is emergency_stop until speed reaches zero.
Haul Road Overspeed Interlock: Autonomous truck speed exceeding 20.0 km/h violates open-pit ramp safety limits. Mandatory immediate action is emergency_stop.
High-Risk Operation Authorization Policy: Any operator request Op_risk without a valid cryptographic auth_token (auth_token=False) must be rejected immediately using refuse_operation.

Maintenance directive bulletin for Truck EQ-02 (unit EQ-02): rear hub bearing wear flagged on EQ-02. When EQ-02 engine temperature is between 90.0 C and 105.0 C, required action for EQ-02 is schedule_maintenance.

Engine Lubrication Schedule: Replace diesel engine oil every 250 operating hours or 6 months using API CI-4 15W-40 heavy-duty lubricant.
Brake Pad Wear Inspection: Measure friction lining thickness every 500 hours. Minimum allowable pad thickness is 8 mm; replace axle pairs symmetrically.
Coolant Circuit Overhaul: Check expansion tank level before each shift and flush ethylene-glycol coolant completely every 2000 operating hours.
24V Battery Bank Maintenance: Verify terminal voltage above 22.5 V prior to night-shift dispatch; replace cells below 80 percent rated capacity.
Planetary Transmission Fluid Service: Check sight-glass level every 125 hours and drain fluid every 1000 hours or upon burnt odor detection.
Hoist Hydraulic System Specification: Nominal working pressure is 250 bar. Replace high-pressure return filters every 500 operating hours.
Haul Truck Tire Cold Inflation: Maintain 850 kPa on rear dual tires and 700 kPa on front steer tires measured cold before shift start.
